description: React component for managing and uploading a custom brand image in the admin console of Mattermost, including image display, upload, delete, and save actions.

classes.name: BrandImageSetting
classes.description: React component for configuring the brand image in the admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches current brand image status and registers save action.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates image preview when a new image is selected.

methods.name: handleImageChange
methods.description: Handles image file selection and updates state.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the image or deletes it via API calls.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI including image display, upload button, and error messages.
